sentences.en: The way tourists dress offends the local standard of propriety.
sentences.zh: 游客的着装冒犯了当地的行为规范。

sentences.en: She seems to have been offended by what he said.
sentences.zh: 她似乎被他说的话冒犯了。

sentences.en: This letter contains sensitive information that may offend some people.
sentences.zh: 这封信包含敏感信息，可能会让一些人感到不快。
